function playSound(freq, duration){ const ctx = new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)(); const oscillator = ctx.createOscillator(); const gain = ctx.createGain(); oscillator.type='sine'; oscillator.frequency.value=freq; oscillator.connect(gain); gain.connect(ctx.destination); oscillator.start(); gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.1, ctx.currentTime); oscillator.stop(ctx.currentTime+duration); }
